scope.basis: Automated first-pass candidate grouping of accepted preview cards based on their actual back wording; each group may require multiple separate images.
scope.completeness: Not a manual handbook-image extraction or exhaustive per-card semantic audit; misses and false positives are possible. Some matching cards describe verbal rules rather than visual recognition tasks. Inspect each exact scenario and existing course before decisions. Sources, currentness and accuracy remain subject to independent review.
scope.current_observation: Proposed needs only; absence or presence of an existing image is not asserted.

sources.page_number_note: Source-card page and source-ref are copied verbatim; null means missing, not inferred.

asset_policy.signs: Use accurate authoritative sign artwork only after verifying local applicability and reuse rights; do not invent signs.
asset_policy.diagrams: Check scenario and visual details against current official state evidence before production; do not infer unstated rules.
asset_policy.accessibility: Provide accurate alt text and do not rely on color alone.
asset_policy.cross_state: Reusable artwork requires state-specific scenario and source review.

method.classification_caveat: Keyword rules can overmatch, miss topics, or classify a text rule as visual recognition. Manual review is required.
method.join_caveat: Lesson and quiz links share fact IDs with cards in the same section; these are suggestions, not confirmed placements.
method.coverage_note: Only accepted card files listed in the pinned manifest were scanned; unmatched cards remain unreviewed and may need images.
